answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling: every grading task draws a random committee from identities that have earned standing through verified work and staked collateral. A fake identity has zero standing, so it is never sampled; buying influence means buying or aging reputation, which is slow and costly. When an attack collapses, the exposed committee's stake is slashed, starting a spiral of loss that makes forgery a relic no rational attacker revives, since an identity without real history is hollow and worthless.
